details.metaDescription: Find opportunities to share your feedback about ODDS
details.mainContent:
Developmental Disabilities Community Engagement
 
 

 

The Office of Developmental Disabilities Services (ODDS) is always working to better support and serve individuals and families. We’re committed to engaging members of the community and learning from your feedback. Use the resources on this page to learn more about participating in our work.

 Policy feedback Workgroups and RACs Events calendar

 Monthly community conversations


How can we continue to improve our services? The ODDS leadership team invites you to meet with us and share your experiences. We host in-person sessions across the state. Please come! You’ll have a chance to learn more about ODDS and our services. We’ll have a discussion. We’ll hear your feedback and experiences.

Join ODDS leadership on Zoom to share your feedback. All are welcome to attend these virtual meetings. 

We meet every first Wednesday of the month from noon to 1 p.m.

Join the meetings on Zoom 


No registration required.
We also invite you to send your questions or feedback ahead of time using the feedback form.
You can fill it out in Arabic, English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Somali, Spanish and Vietnamese.
Deadline: Please send your questions by 8 a.m. on the Monday before the meeting.
You don’t have to submit a question to attend the meeting. You can also ask new questions during the meeting.
If we can’t answer your question during the meeting, a staff member will get back to you via email.
If you want privacy, you can also ask us to respond by email.


We'll see you there!


Other opportunities

Public comment on waivers
SACU redesign project
